content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
Sections: 8.4.4 Anticoagulation Therapy Before and After Catheter Ablation
Key Points: Anticoagulation therapy is crucial before and after atrial fibrillation catheter ablation to prevent complications such as stroke and thromboembolism.
Comparative studies have been conducted on different anticoagulants, including apixaban, warfarin, and edoxaban, with varying results.
The use of diffusion cerebral magnetic resonance imaging to detect silent thromboembolic lesions is discussed.
Health outcomes related to catheter ablation vs. antiarrhythmic drug therapy are analyzed, indicating different impacts on stroke and death rates.
Outcomes of Medicare beneficiaries post-ablation are included in assessments.
